title: Oh there is absolutely no way I’m missing this, omg!!!  #DianePaulus ...
transcript: I am a little bit sick. But listen, they just announced a new immersive Diane Paulus musical featuring the music of David Bowie. So obviously I'm going to come on here and talk about it. Diane Paulus is the director behind masquerade, the immersive Phantom of the opera production playing in New York right now. If you've been watching this page for any amount of time, you know that I am obsessed. I think it is an absolute theatrical triumph. And so to find out that she is doing another immersive musical, this time with the music of David Bowie, um, say less. We don't know much else about the show at the moment, but we do know it's going to be playing in the Greater Boston area next summer as part of the American Repertory Theater's latest season. Diane Paulus is the artistic director there. A lot of her Broadway shows have started there, including Waitress, Finding Neverland, the Pippin Revival. and this new show, life on Mars, is actually going to open their brand new theatre space. So I'm very intrigued to see just how immersive this production is, because obviously with something like masquerade, they were able to convert five stories of an existing building, whereas this new venue, while it sounds like it is going to be very adaptable in terms of its staging options, is going to be a more traditional theatre venue. So I am very intrigued. The project is sanctioned by the Bowie Estate. And rest assured, you will be seeing me in Boston next summer.
showTitle: Life on Mars (unreleased Diane Paulus/Bowie musical at ART)
classificationReason: Reacting to the announcement of a new immersive Bowie musical not on the list. Masquerade is only referenced as background context for the director.
